title: Independent DXF import of physical AC1021 RASTERVARIABLES selected output
scope: Run LibreDWG 0.14 against the exact ASCII/Binary DXF outputs produced by the bounded AC1021 physical RASTERVARIABLES bridge. Distinguish parsing the DXF from successful independent output graph preservation.

physicalSource.sourceObject: RASTERVARIABLES handle 0x2D2, direct NOD key ACAD_IMAGE_VARS
physicalSource.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; author/producer are unauthenticated.

outputGeneration.result: PASS, exit 0. The bounded physical-source wrapper, ASCII/Binary export, local typed readback, invalid-state atomic refusal and same-adapter retry all ran. Only DXF outputs were retained under /private/tmp; no fixture was committed.

independentReader.asciiAndBinaryDxfImport: Both ASCII and Binary inputs parse the RASTERVARIABLES object. Verbose trace reports object handle 0xB500; NOD owner/reactor handle 0xC; class_version=0, image_frame=1, image_quality=1, units=1. Conversion with --as r2004 exits 0 for both files.
independentReader.r2007Boundary: The DXF parse reaches the same typed fields for both encodings, then dxf2dwg exits 1 because LibreDWG 0.14 does not encode R2007. No R2007 DWG is produced.
independentReader.r2004DowngradeReadback: dwgread parses each generated R2004 DWG and finds one RASTERVARIABLES object with class_version=0, image_frame=1, image_quality=1 and units=1. The NOD ACAD_IMAGE_VARS edge and reactor-to-NOD are present. However, the decoded object ownerhandle is [12,2,46324,12], and no object with handle 0xB4F4/46324 is present in OBJECTS. This independent conversion therefore does not preserve a closed owner graph; do not interpret it as successful semantic roundtrip.
independentReader.interpretation: Independent DXF syntax and selected-field parsing is demonstrated. Independent graph-preserving roundtrip, native raster display/unit meaning, producer-wide behavior and whole-source conversion remain unqualified.

validation.physicalSelector: PASS, exit 0 for the AC1021 source bridge and both encodings.
validation.independentAsciiBinaryImport: PASS; LibreDWG reports the selected fields for both.
validation.independentR2004GraphReadback: FAIL CLOSED for owner closure: target handle 46324 is missing, despite the expected NOD membership/reactor and scalar fields.

nextAction: Keep the RASTERVARIABLES bridge bounded. Native consumer checks for display and unit semantics and broader source/version coverage remain open; the LibreDWG R2004 owner anomaly is peer-route evidence and does not justify changing libdxfrw without an independent defect in this repository.
